done.title: आधी रात की सीटी
done.summary: Detective Vikram investigates a young woman's mysterious death in a creepy Banaras haveli, uncovering a lethal plot involving a dead snake, locked rooms, and hidden wealth before receiving a chilling message from the Black Lotus.

done.title: दीवार के अंदर कौन?
done.summary: Detective Vikram uncovers a daring bank heist disguised as a supernatural wall-knocking ghost and an eccentric society for men with a white streak in their hair.
